description: Source code for the mod_userdir plugin in lighttpd, handling user directory mapping and request processing.

methods.name: mod_userdir_free
methods.description: Frees allocated resources in plugin data.

methods.name: mod_userdir_merge_config_cpv
methods.description: Merges individual config plugin value into plugin_config.

methods.name: mod_userdir_merge_config
methods.description: Merges multiple config plugin values into plugin_config.

methods.name: mod_userdir_patch_config
methods.description: Applies configuration patches based on request and plugin data.

methods.name: mod_userdir_set_defaults
methods.description: Sets default configuration values for the plugin.

methods.name: mod_userdir_in_vlist_nc
methods.description: Checks if a username is in the exclude list (case-insensitive).

methods.name: mod_userdir_in_vlist
methods.description: Checks if a username is in the include list (case-sensitive).

methods.name: mod_userdir_docroot_construct
methods.description: Constructs the physical document root path for user directories.

methods.name: mod_userdir_docroot_handler
methods.description: Handles requests to user directories, mapping URLs to filesystem paths.

methods.name: mod_userdir_plugin_init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, setting function pointers and version.
